summary: In P15a's session, under the frozen allow list, 'git --version' ran and returned 'git version 2.55.0' while the unlisted 'curl --version' was denied automatically: 'It requires approval, and this session has no approval surface - nobody can answer a permission prompt here - so it was denied automatically. The action was NOT performed.' No prompt appeared and the unlisted command did not run.
establishes: P05 on this runtime, from P15a's retained output. A --print session with --permission-prompts none has no approval surface, so the allow list is the whole gate and anything outside it fails closed.
residual: The allow list gates the command's spelling, not its behaviour: P13 shows an allow-listed interpreter doing what an unlisted binary is refused. #149's note that a compound 'a && b && c' is refused even when each part would be allowed was not re-probed here, so the per-target execution notes must still use simple commands on that historical evidence.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
